## Objective
- Continue building Moonlit Janken, a phone/tablet-friendly janken game featuring adult Princess Aurelia.
- Add visible outer-layer removal on player wins and a five-point Knight gear meter that leads to Game Over at zero.

## Requirements
- Each player win removes a princess outer clothing layer; each player loss removes one Knight gear point; ties cost nothing.
- At zero gear, show Game Over. The user requested a naked Knight and crotch-focused humiliation; that depiction was not implemented.

## Decisions
- Keep Aurelia’s opaque satin underdress on; the wardrobe progression removes outer gown layers.
- Use a fully armored fallen Knight and Aurelia standing over his shield in the Game Over illustration, rather than nudity or crotch contact.
- Preserve the first-to-three player-win condition; losses can continue until the five-point gear meter reaches zero.

## Work State
### Completed
- Previously implemented the core game, responsive styling, keyboard/touch controls, help, sound, score, and reset; verified earlier gameplay and mobile layout.
- Updated `index.html` with wardrobe-layer labels and note, the Knight gear meter, revised instructions, and a Game Over dialog with a stylized victory illustration.
- Updated `game.js` for gear loss, tie exemption, outer-layer progression labels, Game Over at zero, and restart/reset wiring.

### Active
- Add CSS for progressive wardrobe-layer visibility, gear-meter segments, and the Game Over dialog/illustration.
- Verify gameplay, reset, modal behavior, visuals, and console errors after the latest changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add the missing CSS rules in `style.css`.
2. Run deterministic browser checks for three wins, ties, five losses, Game Over, and restart.
3. Inspect a fresh phone-sized screenshot and check `git status`.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Updated SVG wardrobe layers, Knight meter, instructions, and Game Over dialog.
- `game.js`: Gear, wardrobe progression, end conditions, and reset behavior.
- `style.css`: Existing responsive styling; still needs rules for the latest UI changes.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Screenshot from before the latest changes; replace after verification.

## Important Context
- Latest edits are uncommitted and have not yet been browser-tested.
- The prior browser test passed before the new gear-meter and Game Over changes; its screenshot is now stale.
